reason: 'bractées et bractéoles ... de 1 mm de long': the bracts are 1 mm long.

The first figure of 'leaf blade ... 3-7(-10) × 1-2(-3) cm' is the length, and the extreme maximum is 10.

fix: Read 'short-lived perennial' as perennial life span. 'short-lived' only qualifies it and cannot stand in for it.
reason: The alternative is annual or perennial. Using decreased life span alone loses 'perennial'.
'stigmas 3, ± long': the stigmas are rather long, and the ± is kept as 'approximately'.

fix: In 'not conspicuously X', the 'not' applies to 'conspicuously', not to X. It means sparsely or obscurely X, not 'X absent'. The word 'within' also places it on the adaxial (inner) surface.
reason: The stipule may still be hairy inside, just not conspicuously so. Negating 'hairy' says more than the flora does.
The upper pair of calyx lobes is joined into a lobe ± 9 mm long. The context slot 'upper' keeps the right series member.

fix: In 'base obtuse or cuneate' inside a leaf blade description, the shape belongs to the leaf lamina base, not the whole leaf.
reason: Obtuse and cuneate describe the base of the blade. The leaf as a whole is elliptic to oblong-lanceolate.

fix: 'Limbe (des feuilles)' is the leaf lamina, and its measurements belong to the lamina.
reason: The width 1.7-3 cm is that of the blade ('Limbe des feuilles ... de 5-7 X 1,7-3 cm'). The petiole is measured separately.
'stamens 14'.
'Inflorescence ... densely many flowered': many flowers are present in the inflorescence.
The stamens are adnate to the base of the corolla tube, and 'towards' points to that base.
'Stems spreading, green to yellowish' is a colour range on the stem.

fix: In Asteraceae, 'ray florets ...; laminae' is the limb of the fused corolla of the ray floret, not a petal. Use corolla with the ray flower (PO_0025331) as the whole.
reason: Ray florets have a sympetalous corolla. The 1.5–2 mm width is that of its lamina.
'margin entire, sub-revolute' means slightly revolute, kept with a qualifier.
'Not climbing' is a negated climbing habit of the plant.
On the berry, 'style not persistent' means the style is not persistent.
'styles 2'.
'a petiole virtually absent' means the leaves are practically sessile.
The anthers are 'not exserted'.
'pétiole non quadrangulaire'.
'leaflets 6-10' on an even-pinnate leaf.
'margin 2-5-toothed on each side' gives the teeth per side. Yua has compound leaves, so the whole is the leaflet.

fix: In 'Pedicel ..., with N bracteoles', the bracteoles are counted on the pedicel, so the container must be the pedicel. A container equal to the bearer itself is an error.
reason: The container is set to the bracteole itself. The 1-2 bracteoles are borne on the pedicel, below its middle.

fix: 'Stem leaves ...' is the cauline leaf. Keep it apart from the basal leaves described just before.
reason: Only the stem leaves are bractlike. The basal leaves are large, 8-12 × 4.5-5.5 cm.
'filament whitish' is near-white, kept with a qualifier.
'Perennials, stemless': no aerial stem. The leaves are basal, from a rhizome.
'buds fusiform'.

fix: In 'venation ± raised', the quality belongs to the veins, not the whole leaf or leaflet.
reason: It is the venation that is raised, on both surfaces.
'opposite pair of small linear bracts' means 2 bracts.
